parts.text: I am responsible for the flight, and I can call off a flight. Before and during a flight, things happen outside my control, such as the load being ready or not, the drone reaching the points of its job, and the drone arriving. People and devices outside report these things, while batteries drain faster in cold and wind than planned. Radio coverage is patchy, and reports from drones can arrive late, out of order, more than once, or not at all.
